work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Apostolic letter CXCVIII raises the new cathedral of San Salvador to a minor basilica at Bishop Jorge de Viteri’s request; intitulation, narrative, grant, decernentes and non obstantibus clauses and dating clause survive. Its provenance note1 is LF36928. Issuer evidence: GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF36809–36809; the source dating clause at LF36882–36885 reads: Datum Romae apud s. Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die decima februarii millesimo octin- gentesimo quadragesimo tertio, pontificatus No- stri anno decimo tertio. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
